name: std-tag-strip
description: std-tag-strip — inline tag editing ON the document surface: the record's tags render as removable chips with a type-to-add input (a typed name that matches an existing tag attaches it; an unknown name is created in the shared taxonomy first), plus one-click chips for every existing tag not yet attached. Emits TAGS_CHANGED { id, tagIds } — the host organism routes it into its persistor's update; the document's refetch re-scopes the strip. Binds any record carrying a tagIds relation array; the tag store is the shared `tags` collection (std-tag-taxonomy's).

fields.name: name
fields.description: The descriptive label for this tag.

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: Reference to the parent tag in the hierarchy; empty marks a root.

fields.name: docId
fields.description: The open record's id, stashed at SHOW_TAG_STRIP so commits know which row to update.

fields.name: docTagIds
fields.description: The open record's current tag ids, stashed at SHOW_TAG_STRIP for membership tests.

fields.name: pendingTagName
fields.description: The tag name typed or clicked on add, held across the resolve fetch.

fields.name: pendingNames
fields.description: The chip names remaining after a remove, held across the resolve fetch.

events.synonyms: load tags, scope tag strip, show tags

readOnly.label: Read-only?
readOnly.description: When true the strip renders nothing — no add input, no remove, no suggestion chips. Hosts pass a role condition here so read-only viewers rely on the record's read-only rails (which keep showing the tags) instead of an editing surface.
readOnly.synonyms: read only tags, viewer mode, no tag editing, hide tag input
